title: The Broken Porcelain Vase
scene: At 10:15 AM, the prized vase was found broken in the kiln room. Only the owner saw the blue velvet ribbon tied to its handle.

suspects.name: Toby Shaw
suspects.testimony: I browsed the gallery from 10:00 to 10:20 AM—I never touched any vase with a blue velvet ribbon!
suspects.contradiction: Nobody had mentioned the blue velvet ribbon, and a porcelain shard was tucked in Toby's cuff.

suspects.name: Iris Webb
suspects.testimony: I wedged clay at the main table from 9:55 to 10:20 AM, right beside the kiln room door.
suspects.alibiProof: Two apprentices worked across from Iris at the main table from 9:55 to 10:20 AM.

suspects.name: Hugo Klein
suspects.testimony: I sorted glazes in the front shop from 9:50 to 10:15 AM before walking back to the kiln room.
suspects.alibiProof: The shop bell log and a delivery driver confirm Hugo was at the front counter until 10:15 AM.

suspects.name: Cora Lin
suspects.testimony: I sketched patterns on the patio from 10:00 to 10:20 AM; I never went inside the studio.
suspects.alibiProof: The café barista across the street saw Cora sketching on the patio from 10:00 to 10:20 AM.
